parts.name: Leveling Caster Base Plate - 10 Series, 1/4-20 Thread, Clear Anodize
parts.description: Leveling caster base plate that mounts to the end or side of a profile. Requires tap machining service (pg. 11-3) to mount to the profile end.
parts.dimension_notes: C and F are marked TYP on the drawing; G is the thread size (labelled THREAD); H is given as the SHCS size its holes take; K and L are shown on the side view (thickness and overall height).

suggested_hardware.context: Suggested Hardware (Mount to Profile End), 10 series

parts.notes: Required Machining Services: Tap Profile End (Machined: Mount to Profile End), reference page 11-3. A black anodized version, 2406-Black, is listed with the same dimensions and weight.
